Take control of unique heroes, and use powerful street skills to outplay your opponents. Score spectacular goals, perform flashy finishers, and dominate playgrounds inspired by football cultures from around the world. Challenge friends, climb international leagues, improve your characters, and build your career as a street football champion. Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionPlay, explore, and capture moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered adventure across familiar spots from the show. Snap memories solo or side-by-side with a second player, discover Australian wildlife, and turn in-game moments into real fun for Real Life. Say Cheese! Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around Bluey's hometown of Brisbane as you snap photos of the games you play, chase bin chickens and uncover hidden surprises. Each snapshot is saved to your own scrapbook, where you can keep your best moments. Fun for Everyone A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose, while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. Hang out with Muffin, Chloe, Winton and more of Bluey's friends wherever you go, playing with loads of toys and jumping into games from the show, like Shadowlands and Magic Cauldron. Play for Real Life Packed with tips that turn game time into play for Real Life time! Find new ways to play with everyday things in the world around you, turning cushion forts and cardboard boxes into the next big adventure. Kids can explore, play and discover in the game, then take it off the screen and keep the fun going. Snap, Capture, and Collect Build your scrapbook one snap at a time. Every photo unlocks stickers inspired by the friends, wildlife, and games you come across. Arrange these stickers, paint them however you like, and dress up Bluey and Bingo with costumes you unlock along the way. Bluey’s Happy Snaps has no in-game purchases and no online play.Show morePublished byGameloftDeveloped byGameloftPlay withPCXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SHandheldCapabilitiesXbox local co-op (2-2)4K Ultra HDSingle player60 fps+Optimized for Xbox Series X|SSmart DeliveryXbox achievementsXbox cloud savesXbox Play AnywhereCompare editionsBluey's Happy Snaps: Deluxe Edition$39.99+Bluey's Happy Snaps: Deluxe Edition$39.99+Games includedBluey's Happy SnapsAdd-ons includedBluey's Happy Snaps Deluxe DLCGO TO GAMEIncluded inBluey's Happy Snaps: Deluxe Edition$39.99+PRE-ORDERComing to these subscriptionsPC onlyUltimate XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads
